reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Service for Foreign Policy Instruments

title.narrative: Advancing climate resilience: Area C solar power for Gaza and West Bank and regional water security

description.narrative:
Overall objective: Increased regional cooperation and agreement on joint action on climate, energy, and human security.


Specific objectives:

1) There is increased awareness and political will of key national and international decision makers on water security as central to national and regional security.

2) An evidence base is created for implementation of rapid response measures to build climate resilience for Palestinians in Area C of the West Bank, the Jordan Valley, and Gaza.


Outputs:

SO 1

Output 1.1: Through high-level advocacy initiatives, international and regional stakeholders demonstrate increased awareness and engagement on climate and water security issues as a fundamental part of regional security.

Output 1.2: Through national advocacy initiatives, key national stakeholders demonstrate increased awareness of water security issues and potential response measures as a fundamental part of national security.

SO 2

Output 2.1: Evidence-based local initiatives are identified through the design of five concept notes developed through an inclusive consultation process.

Output 2.2: Small-scale pilot projects are conducted in local communities following the mobilisation of funds from key private and public stakeholders.
